draft.author: Lance Zierlein
draft.strengthQuote: Improvement likely, as he's played cornerback for just two years.
draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.00, the 134th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 15th of 37 at CB. He went 153rd overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Kevin King. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (99th percentile), 10-yard split (87th percentile), vertical jump (96th percentile). College production: 5 passes defended in 2021, 18th of 31 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the Philadelphia Eagles. 64 career games and 53 starts over 4 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 3 AV in 2025 against a career-best 10 in 2022. Strengths in 2025: passes defended 12 (88th percentile), completion % allowed 54.2% (84th percentile), passer rating allowed 75.5 (83rd percentile). Versus the typical Year-4 cornerback who played: 72.8% season snap share against a median of 34.8%, above the norm.
